summary: All 62 slugs present in index.ts with matching .vue files; no route name collisions; navbar dropdown and mobile entry correct; ?cat= filter works; build exits 0, 23/23 tests pass. One non-blocking finding: 62 static routes instead of a single /solucoes/:slug param adds per-solution boilerplate.
findings: Static route table vs :slug param — 62 individual routes instead of a single /solucoes/:slug route means route.params.slug is always empty and SolucaoView falls back to route.path.split('/').pop(). Works correctly now, but adding a new solution requires touching solucoes.ts, solucoesMap, and solutionMeta independently. Consider a single parameterized route to reduce boilerplate.
FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 task records have empty findings fields — agents did not record their build/test verification output. No code impact; direct re-run confirms build and tests pass.
